poster.
I hope you're enjoying this workshop for children's book
authors. In this next part of the workshop, we'll look at how
to create characters that are memorable. One way to capture
children's attention is to give a character a special feature.
Here's a poster for the book series Barb and Friends.
ne of the characters always wears a hat—he wears a
different hat on every page! ® Even though he's not the main
character, he's the most popular. There're several children's
books on the table at the back of the room. Please spend
about ten minutes looking through the books on display. Try
to identify the features that make each character unique.
BARB & FRIENDS
Dom
Barb
Marina Liam
Don
Barb
Marina
Liam
